x: In the unofficial top-ten cross country rankings for 1964, Gerry North was ranked 6th behind Batty, Hill, Turner, Cooke and Heatley despite beating three of them in the International Championship.

With only four stages to run, and Hill and Freary in terrific form, it soon became a race for second and North Staffs got us by 17 seconds. The two Bolton stars were each 39 seconds faster than the North brothers---truly fantastic.
No, he's not winning! But he is running a fine race ahead of Freary, Hill, Plain and Jackson in the National Championships. GERRY NORTH eventually finished 17th.

But in this highest level competition the very best would be needed for a medal. Buckley opened with 84.90, Hill with 81.32 and the New Zealand pair pushing 78.00. Nigel could only manage 70.42, improving to 75.66.
